name: dreaming-course-pipeline
description: An agent-handoff course-production workflow that turns weekly materials and bundled Dharawal stories into reviewed, narrative-led teaching decks.

interface.longDescription: Six linked workflow skills use fresh-agent handoffs for source preservation, processing, mandatory attributed use of the bundled Dharawal story library, blueprint and image review, PowerPoint assembly, and QA.
capabilities: Six linked course-production skills with agent handoffs
Required attributed use of the bundled Dharawal story library
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $dreaming-course-setup-project to start the automatic Dreaming Course Pipeline from my course materials.
